campaign_thesis: Invite account holders to inspect aggregate usage signals in a pressure-free environment, with optional, consent-gated sharing of workflow observations.
tone_rules: Evidence-disciplined: every claim must be traceable to exact source evidence
No urgency, scarcity, fear, or outcome promises
Treat customer attention as borrowed, never owed

email_invitation.subject: Your team's usage signals are ready to inspect
email_invitation.preheader: Explore patterns at your own pace—no action required
body_paragraphs: You are receiving this email because your account holds aggregate usage data for Copper Finch.

This invitation lets you inspect your team's Feature Adoption (29.08% current / 41.04% previous), Active Users (120 current / 141 previous), Session Frequency (4.85 current / 3.77 previous), and Seat Utilisation (75.95%) as inspect-only objects.
You may also see an open medium-severity workflow support case if relevant to your team's signals.
The experience is optional and pressure-free: you can explore signals, share an observation about workflow friction (not required), or decline at any point without consequence.
After engaging or closing, you will see a thank-you message that prescribes no next step: 'Thank you for exploring your signal garden. Your team's patterns are yours to act on—or not.'

transparency.why_received: You are receiving this email because your account holds aggregate usage data for Copper Finch.
transparency.data_boundary: All signals are account-level observations for Copper Finch; they are not personal, individual, user-level, diagnostic, or causal explanations for any change.
transparency.choice_statement: You may inspect signals, share an observation about workflow friction (optional, not required), or decline at any point. Non-response is not consent and triggers no follow-up. All decline paths—email non-engagement, 'Not now' in modal, or modal dismiss—are complete and valid outcomes with no implied obligation.

manager_handoff.executive_summary: The Signal Garden experience is built as specified: aggregate signals are inspect-only, observation sharing is explicit and optional, and all decline paths are honored without side effects. Communication uses only the email channel and avoids urgency, persuasion, or outcome promises.
decision_questions: Does the email body preserve aggregate-level framing and avoid any personal, individual, diagnostic, or causal language?
Are all claims in the email and transparency copy traceable to exact source evidence without added interpretation?
Is the CTA limited to viewing the Signal Garden and free of any request to book, buy, upgrade, call, or share data beyond optional observation sharing?
Does the transparency section fully explain why the email was received, the data boundary, and the complete decline path?
Are there any prohibited channels (SMS, phone, push) or urgency/scarcity/fear language present in the draft?
operational_dependencies: Email deployment must use only the approved recipient list: account holders of Copper Finch who have not opted out of product communications
Landing route #/cases/recovery-room must be accessible and render the Recovery Room artefact as validated
No automated sequence or follow-up may be triggered without new explicit consent from the customer

risks.risk: Customer may perceive signal inspection as judgment despite neutral framing.
risks.mitigation: Signal strands are labelled as observational data with explicit 'No action required' messaging; tone is curious, not corrective.

risks.risk: Optional clarification could feel like a soft sell.
risks.mitigation: Clarification request is framed as helping improve the signal garden itself, not the product; observation field is optional and not required to proceed.

required_disclosures: The experience uses only the email channel for outreach, as permitted by the preference profile.
No data from signal inspection is stored, used for profiling, or persisted without explicit consent to share an observation.
The observation sharing is explicit, purpose-limited to improving the signal garden, and not required to proceed.
All aggregate signals are account-level observations; they are not personal, individual, user-level, diagnostic, or causal explanations for any change.
The experience respects WCAG 2.2 AA standards for contrast, focus, keyboard navigation, screen-reader access, and reduced motion.
A decline at any point (email non-engagement, 'Not now' in modal, or modal dismiss) is a complete and valid outcome with no implied obligation or follow-up.
